2026-10-20 23:45:28.282300 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-10-20 23:45:28.282304 | controller |
2026-10-20 23:45:28.282309 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-10-20 23:45:28.282313 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-10-20 23:45:28.282329 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-10-20 23:45:28.282344 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-10-20 23:45:28.282358 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
